risks: set() shadows Python's builtin set at module scope -- documented in module docstring; __all__ keeps it explicit; callers must import the module, not the names (watermark.set(...)). Flagged for code review convention.
get() opens its own autocommit connection -- intentional for a pure SELECT; readers cross txn boundaries must see the committed state. Not a correctness concern for the staged UPSERT pattern.
DSN fallback 'postgresql://etl4:change_me@localhost:5432/etl4' carries 'change_me' placeholder; matches etl4/sink/postgres.py convention. Real credentials come from POSTGRES_DSN env var.
